description: Recipe (receta) of a sellable product: what one sale consumes. A rule says 'selling this product — or this one option choice of it — consumes N of a component'. The component is either a tracked stock item (products.trackInventory = 1, e.g. '8L ARIEL REG' counted in ml) whose inventory goes down on every sale, or a service product included in a kit (e.g. Servicio Completo › Básico includes 1 × 'Servicio de lavado › Basico' and 1 × 'Servicio de secado › 40 Min'), which moves no stock and is only listed. Example: Servicio Completo › Básico = 100 ml Ariel + 100 ml Suavitel + 1 lavado Básico + 1 secado 40 min.

fields.name: productId
fields.description: The sellable product (what the cashier sells), e.g. 1004 Servicio Completo.

fields.name: productOptionChoiceId
fields.description: The choice of the sellable the rule applies to (Servicio Completo › Ciclo › Básico). NULL = every sale of the product. Choice ids are stable since 2026-10-27 (sp_products upserts by id).

fields.name: componentProductId
fields.description: What is consumed: a stock item (trackInventory = 1) or a service product of the same company. Never the same product as productId.

fields.name: componentProductOptionChoiceId
fields.description: For a service component, which of its choices is included ('Servicio de secado › 40 Min'). NULL for stock items.

fields.name: quantity
fields.description: Amount consumed per 1 unit sold, expressed in the component's products.stockUnit (ml, g or pz). For a service component: number of cycles (usually 1).

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: 1 = applied on sales; 0 = kept for history but ignored.

relationships.notes: Multi-tenant isolation via companyId — injected automatically by stored procedures.
A sellable has 0..N rules (FK productId); a stock item or service is the component of 0..N rules (FK componentProductId).
Optional: the rule applies to one choice of the sellable; optional: the included choice of a service component.

components.name: ProductWizard › Opciones › 'Incluye / consume'
components.description: Existing src/components/pos/productWizard/ProductWizard.tsx: per option choice, a list of rules (component picker + quantity in the component's stockUnit). Saved with productConsumptionApi after the product is saved (choice ids come back from sp_products_one).

hints: Standard CRUD action 1/2/3 in sp_productConsumptions; action=0 not needed.

Batch replace: action=1 with productId and productConsumptions[] (all rules of that product) replaces the product's set in one transaction — rows not in the payload are deleted; the wizard saves the whole recipe at once.

sp_productConsumptions_all filters by companyId and optional productId; returns each rule with component name, component stockUnit, component trackInventory, and the names of both choices (LEFT JOIN productOptionChoices).

Validate in the SP: componentProductId belongs to the same companyId; productOptionChoiceId (if not NULL) belongs to productId; componentProductOptionChoiceId (if not NULL) belongs to componentProductId.

UNIQUE (productId, productOptionChoiceId, componentProductId, componentProductOptionChoiceId) — use a filtered/computed approach since NULLs are allowed (ISNULL(...,0) in a persisted computed column or validate in the SP).
Sale posting is NOT part of this module: trg_incomeDetails_inventory reads this table in a separate hand-written migration.
